text:
Watch and follow on Apple and Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.
The U.S.-Canada trade war is escalating from tariffs to outright import bans, with Washington blocking roughly a billion dollars' worth of Canadian dairy, alcohol, motorcycles and Bombardier jets. Meanwhile, the U.S.-Iran conflict shows no sign of winding down, pushing oil back above $100 a barrel. And on Wall Street, the release of OpenAI's GPT-6 weighs on software stocks even as chip stocks rally on continued AI infrastructure spending.
